# Systems: Larkspur Ceramics

- [MEDIUM E-06] Email: carries every purchase order as a PDF attachment.
- [HIGH E-01] The shared order sheet: purchase order number, customer, product code, quantity, ship date.
- [HIGH E-04, E-05] QuickBooks Online: 212 items and 1,140 invoices in a year; no connection to the sheet or to email.
- [HIGH E-12, E-13] Quillfeather POS, in the studio shop: its API lists each sale's line items by product code, up to 120 requests a minute (the vendor's own reference).
- [UNKNOWN] Whether the warehouse would use a screen instead of the printed picks. Who can answer: operations manager.
